section1.title: 1. Amakuru Turakusanya
body: Turakusanya amakuru utanga muburyo butaziguye (nkizina ryawe na aderesi imeri mugihe utanze urupapuro rwabigenewe cyangwa ugashiraho konti) hamwe namakuru yakusanyirijwe mu buryo bwikora binyuze muri kuki hamwe nikoranabuhanga risa, nkurupapuro rwasuwe, ubwoko bwibikoresho hamwe n’ahantu hegereye.

section2.title: 2. Uburyo dukoresha kuki
body: Kuki zingenzi zihora zishoboka kuko urubuga rudashobora gukora neza utarinze kubikora. Babika amasomo no kwemeza leta kandi bakibuka ibyo ukunda kuki.

Isesengura rya kuki ridufasha kumva uburyo abashyitsi bakoresha urubuga kugirango tubashe kunoza. Kwamamaza ibicuruzwa bikoreshwa kugirango bikwereke ibyifuzo hamwe nubukangurambaga. Ibi byiciro bishobojwe gusa nubushake bwawe kandi birashobora guhinduka mugihe icyo aricyo cyose uhereye kumwanya wa kuki.

section3.title: 3. Ishingiro ryamategeko (GDPR)
body: Dutunganya amakuru yihariye kumategeko akurikira: kwemererwa kwawe (kubitari ngombwa kuki no kwamamaza), gukora amasezerano (kuri serivisi usaba), inshingano zemewe, ninyungu zemewe aho uburenganzira bwawe butabarenze. Urashobora kuvanaho uruhushya umwanya uwariwo wose utagize ingaruka ku mategeko yo gutunganya byakozwe mbere yo kuva.

section4.title: 4. Uburenganzira bwawe
body: Ukurikije aho uherereye, urashobora kugira uburenganzira bwo kubona, gukosora, gusiba, cyangwa kugabanya itunganywa ryamakuru yawe bwite, kwanga gutunganywa, no kubikwirakwiza. Urashobora kandi gutanga ikirego mubuyobozi bwibanze.

section5.title: 5. Kubika Data & Umutekano
body: Tugumana amakuru yihariye gusa igihe cyose bikenewe kubwintego zasobanuwe muri iyi politiki. Dukoresha ingamba zikwiye za tekiniki nu muteguro kugirango turinde amakuru yawe kutinjira, guhindura, gutangaza cyangwa gusenya.

section6.title: 6. Serivisi zindi-Zindi
body: Kuki zimwe zishobora gushyirwaho nabandi batanga isoko (nka analyse cyangwa urubuga rwo kwamamaza) bidufasha gukoresha urubuga. Abatanga amakuru batunganya amakuru muri politiki yabo bwite kandi mugihe wemeye icyiciro kibishinzwe.

ai-robotics-solutions.tagline: Ikoranabuhanga ryubwenge. Ibikorwa byikora. Ubucuruzi Bwiza.
overview: Ubwenge bwa artificiel na Robo bihindura uburyo amashyirahamwe akora, gufata ibyemezo, no gutanga agaciro. Ibisubizo byacu bya AI & Robotics bifasha ubucuruzi kurenga automatike gakondo muguhuza ubwenge bwubukorikori, kwiga imashini, icyerekezo cya mudasobwa, gukoresha ubwenge bwikora, hamwe na robo kugirango bikemure ibibazo byubucuruzi.

Dutegura ibisubizo byubwenge hafi yubucuruzi bupima. Niba ibisabwa ari uguhindura imirimo isubiramo, gusesengura umubare munini wamakuru, kumenya uburyo, gushyigikira ibyemezo, cyangwa kwinjiza robotike mubikorwa bikora, inzira yacu yibanda kubwizerwa, ubwuzuzanye, umutekano, nagaciro kigihe kirekire mubucuruzi.
transformation: Amashyirahamwe agezweho atanga amakuru menshi kandi akora ibikorwa ibihumbi byisubiramo buri munsi. AI hamwe na robo irashobora guhindura ibyo bikorwa mubikorwa byubwenge, byikora bikora neza byongera umusaruro mugihe byemerera abakozi kwibanda kumurimo ufite agaciro gakomeye.

Ibisubizo byacu birashobora gufasha amashyirahamwe gukora ibikorwa byisubiramo, kugabanya ibikorwa byintoki, kunoza ukuri, gusesengura amakuru akomeye, gushyigikira ibyemezo byihuse, guhuza imikoreshereze yumutungo, kuzamura uburambe bwabakiriya, no kubaka sisitemu yubwenge nini.

customDevelopment.description: Iterambere-iherezo-ryibisubizo bishya bya digitale bivuye mubisabwa mubucuruzi no gukemura ibisubizo binyuze mumajyambere, kwishyira hamwe, kugerageza, kubohereza, hamwe ninkunga ikomeje.
customDevelopment.row1P1: Buri gikorwa gishya cya digitale gitangirana nibisabwa byihariye, ibikorwa byakazi, hamwe nintego zifatika zidashobora kugerwaho na software imwe-imwe. Dufite ubuhanga bwo kubaka imigenzo, imikorere-yimikorere ya software kuva kera.
customDevelopment.row1P2: Uhereye kubisabwa byambere kuvumburwa hamwe nubuhanga bwububiko bwa tekinike kugeza iterambere ryihuta, iterambere ryibidukikije rya API, imiyoboro igerageza ikomeye, hamwe nogukoresha ibicu byikora, amakipe yacu akomeye yubuhanga afite uburenganzira bwibicuruzwa byawe.
customDevelopment.row2Title: Sisitemu nini yubatswe mu kuzamura imishinga
customDevelopment.row2P1: Dushushanya ibikoresho byubaka software bigenewe kwihanganira imitwaro iremereye. Kuva kuri microservices ya modular hamwe nibyabaye-biganisha inyuma kugeza kumurongo-mwinshi winjiza amakuru hamwe na GraphQL / REST APIs, twubaka urubuga rupima imbaraga.
customDevelopment.row2P2: Mugushiraho codebase isukuye, modular ihujwe no kwipimisha mu buryo bwikora no kubahiriza umutekano uhoraho, turemeza ko fondasiyo ya software ikomeza, igenzurwa, kandi yiteguye kwihindagurika ryigihe kirekire.
customDevelopment.row3Title: Gutanga Agile hamwe na Imiyoboro Yikora
customDevelopment.row3P1: Icyitegererezo cyacu cyo gutanga gikubiyemo ibice byikora, kwishyira hamwe, hamwe no kugerageza gusubira inyuma kugeza ku ndunduro hamwe na CI / CD ikora (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS / Azure / GCP).
customDevelopment.row3P2: Hamwe na disikuru igaragara neza, igihe nyacyo cyo kwitegereza, hamwe n'umuvuduko ukabije wihuta, turemeza ko byihuta-ku-isoko tutabangamiye umutekano, umutekano, cyangwa uburambe bwabakoresha.
customDevelopment.row4Title: Yizewe 24/7 Ibikorwa hamwe nubwihindurize bwigihe kirekire
customDevelopment.row4P1: Kujya live ni intangiriro. Dutanga igenzura rifatika, kubungabunga SLA ishyigikiwe, gutezimbere ibikorwaremezo, guhuza imikorere, hamwe nibikorwa bikomeza.
customDevelopment.row4P2: Itsinda ryacu ryubwubatsi rikora nk'iyaguka risanzwe ryumuryango wawe, ryemeza ko zeru zidahwema kandi zikomeza ubuhanga bwikoranabuhanga ku isoko ryawe.
customDevelopment.pillarsSub: Ubushobozi bwuzuye-bwuzuye bushoboye gukora ibitekerezo byawe kuva kuri zeru kugeza kumusaruro.
customDevelopment.pillar1Desc: Isesengura ryimbitse ryibikorwa byubucuruzi, ibisobanuro bikora, hamwe nu ikarita yurugendo rwo gukoresha kugirango usobanure imipaka nyayo.
customDevelopment.pillar2Desc: Igicu kinini-cyubatswe kavukire, kwerekana ububiko bwububiko, igishushanyo mbonera cya microservices, hamwe nishingiro ryumutekano zero.
customDevelopment.pillar3Desc: Urubuga rugezweho rwuzuye-porogaramu igendanwa ikozwe na code isukuye, ubwoko-umutekano, hamwe na UI igaragara.
customDevelopment.pillar4Desc: Byinshi-byinjira REST / GraphQL APIs, orchestre ya webhook, amarembo yo kwishura, hamwe nundi muntu wa gatatu ERP / CRM sync.
customDevelopment.ctaTitle: Witeguye kubaka igisubizo cyawe kuva cyatangira kugeza kubyoherejwe?
customDevelopment.ctaSub: Umufatanyabikorwa na Oklut Technologies kububatsi, injeniyeri, no gukoresha urubuga rwawe rwa digitale kuva mubisabwa mubucuruzi kugeza mubikorwa byukuri.
customDevelopment.pillar5Desc: Gukoresha ibizamini bikomeye, kugerageza umutwaro / guhangayika, gusikana intege nke, hamwe na suite yikizamini.
customDevelopment.pillar6Desc: Imiyoboro ya CI / CD yikora, orchestre ya kontineri (Docker / K8s), ibikorwa remezo nka code, hamwe na zeru-yamanutse.
customDevelopment.pillar7Desc: 24/7 gukurikirana ibikorwa, telemeteri yubuzima, kugenzura imikorere, kugenzura umutekano, no gukomeza kubungabunga SLA.
customDevelopment.pillar8Desc: Ibisanzwe biranga umuvuduko, guhuza amakuru yisesengura, kuzamura AI, no kuvugurura imyubakire.

processAutomation.description: Kurangiza-kurangiza gutangiza ibikorwa byakazi, guhuza ibikorwa bya robo yimikorere (RPA), gutunganya inyandiko zubwenge, moteri yubucuruzi, hamwe no guhuza sisitemu.
processAutomation.row1P1: Kuraho intoki zisubirwamo zamakuru, ubwiyunge bwambukiranya sisitemu, hamwe ninzira zinyuranye. Dushiraho imishinga ya RPA ikora imirimo itunganijwe 24/7 hamwe nigipimo cya zeru.
processAutomation.row1P2: Muguhuza umurage wa desktop yumurage, SAP / ERP inyuma, hamwe nububiko bwibicu, bots ya software irekura ikipe yawe kwibanda kubikorwa byubucuruzi.
processAutomation.row2P1: Kwinjiza mu buryo bwikora, gutondekanya, no gukuramo amakuru muri fagitire, amasezerano, ibyangombwa biranga, hamwe nibisabwa. Imiyoboro yacu ikoreshwa na AI yemeza imirima kububiko bwimbere kandi igatera gukora byikora byikora.
processAutomation.row2P2: Kugera ku buryo butaziguye binyuze mu gutunganya ibicuruzwa birenga 95% mugihe ugabanya cyane ibihe byo guhinduka kuva kumunsi kugeza kumasegonda.
processAutomation.row3P1: Huza CRM, ERP, HRMS, na banki APIs muburyo bumwe bwigihe-cyamakuru. Dushyira mubikorwa ibyabaye-bikurura imbarutso, ubutumwa umurongo, hamwe nabashinzwe gusubira inyuma.
processAutomation.row3P2: Amakuru atembera mumashami atabigizemo uruhare, bikuraho silos ikora no gutinda kw'itumanaho.
processAutomation.row4P1: Kurikirana ibihe byakozwe, ikarita yubushyuhe, inshuro zamakosa, hamwe na ROI yimari mugihe nyacyo cyo kuyobora.
processAutomation.row4P2: Gukomeza kwisuzumisha imashini isuzuma uburyo bushya bwo gukoresha, bigatuma ikigo cyawe gikora neza.
processAutomation.pillar2Desc: Amategeko ya software ashingiye kumategeko akora ibikorwa bisanzwe byinjira, ubwiyunge, hamwe nibikorwa byambukiranya imipaka.
processAutomation.pillar3Desc: Imikorere ya AI ikora isobanura imiterere, incamake yinyandiko itubatswe, kandi ifata ibyemezo byikora.
processAutomation.pillar4Desc: Gutunganya ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro, gutahura icyuho, hamwe na Kaizen ikora bikomeza kugabanya ibiciro byakazi.
processAutomation.ctaSub: Ihuze nabubatsi bacu bo kwimenyekanisha kugirango umenye amahirwe-ROI amahirwe kandi ukoreshe ubwenge bwakazi.

centreOfExcellence.description: Ishirahamwe ryibanze ryubwubatsi bukuru ninzobere za domaine zahariwe kugena imikorere yubuhanga, gutwara udushya, no kwihutisha ibikorwa bya digitale.
centreOfExcellence.row1P1: Ikigo cyacu cyindashyikirwa gishyiraho uburyo busanzwe bwo gushushanya, ibizamini byikora byikora, hamwe na zeru-inenge yo gusuzuma kode yihutisha igihe-ku isoko mugihe ideni rya tekiniki kuri zeru.
centreOfExcellence.row1F1: Imiyoboro ya CI / CD irekuye hamwe na DORA metrics isesengura
centreOfExcellence.row1F2: Ikibaho gikomeye cyo gusuzuma ibyubatswe & imiyoborere ya microservices
centreOfExcellence.row1F3: Gukomeza umutekano uhoraho hamwe no guhita byangiza
centreOfExcellence.row2Title: Laboratwari yo guhanga udushya & Ikoranabuhanga rishya
centreOfExcellence.row2P1: Turagerageza hamwe nuburyo bugezweho bwo kwiga imashini yiga imashini, ibikoresho bya AI byabigenewe, hamwe nibikorwa byubwenge byikora kugirango twubake ibicuruzwa bizakurikiraho.
centreOfExcellence.row2F2: Umukozi wigenga wa AI ukora ibikorwa byubucuruzi bwikora
centreOfExcellence.row2F3: Gukoresha imashini yiga imashini igezweho kandi igahuza neza
centreOfExcellence.row3P1: Dushushanya kandi tugacunga ibidukikije byinshi-bicu byubatswe ku rwego rwumutekano wa zeru, tukemeza ko amakuru yawe akomeza kurindwa n’iterabwoba ry’isi yose.
centreOfExcellence.row3F1: AWS, Azure, & GCP ibikorwa remezo byinshi-bicu
centreOfExcellence.row3F2: Zero-kwizerana umuyoboro wa interineti (ZTNA) & politiki ishingiye kuri IAM
centreOfExcellence.row3F3: Automatic kontineri yumutekano gusikana & gucunga ibanga
centreOfExcellence.pillarsSub: Ibitabo byiterambere byateguwe bikoreshwa mubutumwa bukomeye.
centreOfExcellence.pillar1Desc: Igenzura ryuzuye ryemeza ko ibisubizo byibikorwa byose bihuye nubunini bukomeye, umutekano, hamwe na protocole yubahirizwa.
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Desc: Sisitemu yo gushushanya nyirizina, ibikoresho byo gutangiza API, hamwe na microservice yinyuma bigabanya igihe cyiterambere cyambere 40%.
centreOfExcellence.pillar3Desc: Iterambere ryukuri-ryigihe cyo kugenzura imiyoboro ikurikirana ubukererwe bwa porogaramu, ibicuruzwa byinjira, hamwe nigicu gikoreshwa.
centreOfExcellence.pillar4Desc: Yubatswe imbere yimbere hamwe nimpamyabumenyi ihinga ubuhanga bwimbitse bwa tekinike hejuru yibicu, DevOps, hamwe na AI ikoreshwa.
centreOfExcellence.ctaSub: Umufatanyabikorwa hamwe na Oklut Tech's Centre of Excellence kugirango yubake ibicu byubaka, byikora neza, kandi byihutishe itangwa ryibicuruzwa.
centreOfExcellence.p1Desc: Gushiraho imishinga yose yubuyobozi bwububiko, kurinda politiki, hamwe nubuziranenge.
centreOfExcellence.p2Desc: Sobanura ibyubatswe bigezweho, ibikoresho byikoranabuhanga byapimwe, hamwe na microservices.
centreOfExcellence.p3Desc: Kwihutisha umuvuduko witerambere hamwe nibice bisangiwe, inyandikorugero, ibikoresho bitangira, hamwe na sisitemu yo gushushanya.
centreOfExcellence.p4Desc: Amahugurwa yubatswe, ubuhanga bwikoranabuhanga, hamwe nubushobozi bwo kuzamura ubuhanga bwubwubatsi.
centreOfExcellence.p5Desc: R&D kubakozi ba AI, imiyoboro yimodoka, hamwe nibisekuruza bizaza kugirango bikomeze isoko.
centreOfExcellence.p6Desc: Ibipimo byubushakashatsi bwakozwe na DORA (DORA), ibipimo bya SLA, hamwe no gukomeza kunoza ubuziranenge.

solutionEngineering.description: Gutezimbere no kuzamura porogaramu, urubuga, urujya n'uruza, hamwe nibisubizo byumushinga kugirango bikemure ubucuruzi budasanzwe no gutanga imikorere ijyanye.
solutionEngineering.row1P1: Porogaramu isanzwe yimishinga ikunze kubura ibyo ikenera ubucuruzi bwihariye. Itsinda ryacu ryubwubatsi ritegura iterambere rya bespoke modules, amategeko yubucuruzi yihariye, hamwe niyagurwa ryihariye rijyanye nibikorwa byawe.
solutionEngineering.row1P2: Duhereye kubikorwa bya CRM na ERP byiyongera kumurongo wihariye wibikorwa, twubaka ibintu bihuza neza nikipe yawe ikora neza.
solutionEngineering.row2Title: Iboneza rya platform & Iterambere rya API
solutionEngineering.row2P1: Huza sisitemu zitandukanye za software muri ecosystem ihuriweho. Dutezimbere injeniyeri REST na GraphQL APIs, abakoresha webhook, hamwe nubutumwa bwubutumwa bwumurongo kugirango tumenye igihe nyacyo cyo guhuza amakuru kurubuga rwawe rwose.
solutionEngineering.row2P2: Haba guhuza igice-cyagatatu ibikoresho bya SaaS cyangwa kwagura ibikorwa byihariye kuri platifomu, ubwubatsi bwacu bwo kwishyira hamwe bushyira imbere ubunyangamugayo bwamakuru, ibyinjira, na zeru zigihe gito.
solutionEngineering.row3P1: Uzamure intera yumurage hamwe nuburyo bugezweho, bwitondewe bwabakoresha bwagenewe umuvuduko no gusobanuka. Twongeye gukora injeniyeri imbere yuburyo bwimbitse bwo gushushanya, kubahiriza ibyagezweho, hamwe nuburyo bworoshye bwimikoranire.
solutionEngineering.row3P2: Mugihe kibangikanye, abashakashatsi bacu bakora neza bahindura ibibazo byububiko, ingamba zo gufata ingamba, hamwe nubunini bwa bundle kugirango batange ibisubizo byihuse mubikoresho byose.
solutionEngineering.pillarsSub: Uburyo bwo gutangiza imishinga-yubucuruzi yubatswe kugirango igere ku ntera.
solutionEngineering.pillar1Desc: Porogaramu yihariye ya logique hamwe na mashini ya leta yimashini yagenwe byumwihariko hafi yimikorere yimbere.
solutionEngineering.pillar2Desc: Ikiraro cyizewe, cyemewe gihuza amakuru yinyuma, suite ya ERP, amarembo yo kwishyura, hamwe na serivise zicu.
solutionEngineering.pillar3Desc: Ihinduka ryimbitse ryubwubatsi rihindura software yibikorwa bitarenze inzira yo kuzamura cyangwa amasezerano yo gushyigikira abacuruzi.
solutionEngineering.pillar4Desc: Ikibazo gikaze cyerekana umwirondoro, kurandura ububiko bwo kwibuka, hamwe no gukwirakwiza CDN kubutaka bwa kabiri.
solutionEngineering.ctaSub: Ihuze nibisubizo byububiko kugirango dushushanye kandi ukoreshe module yihariye, urujya n'uruza, hamwe no guhuza bikwiranye nubucuruzi bwawe.

digitalTransformation.description: Kuvugurura byimazeyo ibikorwa byubucuruzi, imyubakire yikoranabuhanga, hamwe nuburyo bukoreshwa kugirango utere imbere gahunda, imikorere myiza, hamwe niterambere rirambye.
digitalTransformation.row1P1: Dufatanya n'abayobozi b'ibigo gusobanura ingamba za digitale, imanza z'ubucuruzi, hamwe n'ibishushanyo mbonera byerekana ibyiciro byihuse hamwe no kurangiza ibyago.
digitalTransformation.row1P2: Ibikorwa byihutirwa, icyitegererezo cya TCO, na KPIs byemeza ko imbaraga zose zigezweho zikoranabuhanga zijyanye no kwinjiza, gukora neza, hamwe nibisubizo byabakiriya.
digitalTransformation.row2P1: Ongera ushyireho monoliths kuri microservices, APIs, hamwe nigicu-kavukire hamwe na zeru-igihe cyo kugabanya no kwemeza byikora.
digitalTransformation.row2P2: Tuvugurura porogaramu, ububikoshingiro, hamwe nuburyo bwo kwishyira hamwe mugihe turinda kubahiriza umutekano hamwe numutekano.
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Emera AWS, Azure, na GCP, wubake imiyoboro igezweho, kandi ushiremo imashini yiga imashini kugirango itware ibyemezo byigenga.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Kuva mubihe-nyabyo byabaye kugeza kumwanya uhuriweho, guhinduka biba bipimye kandi birambye.
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Ongera uhindure ingendo zabakiriya kurubuga rusubiza, iOS, Android, hamwe na portal-serivisi yihariye hamwe na interineti yihariye.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Ihuriro ryubuhanga, telemetrie, hamwe nibisubizo byikora byikora bituma udushya dukomeza.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Ibisubizo byibanda kubisubizo byemeza ubuyobozi burambye bwa digitale.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Icyiciro gihinduka igishushanyo mbonera cyerekana imishinga yubucuruzi, imiyoborere yububiko, hamwe ningaruka zikurikirana.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: AWS / Azure / GCP ibishingwe byinshi-bicu, imiyoboro ikora, hamwe nubushobozi bwo gusesengura amakuru.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Ubwenge bwibikorwa byubwenge, ubwenge bwa AI, hamwe na telemetrike yo guhanura kugirango ibikorwa bya buri munsi.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Guhindura byinshi cyane imiyoboro ya digitale hamwe ninteruro yihariye yubatswe kubakoresha cyane.
digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Umufatanyabikorwa hamwe na Oklut Technologies yo mu cyiciro, ihindagurika-rishobora guhinduka hifashishijwe umusaruro ufatika.

endToEndSolutions.description: Urwego rutunganijwe, rwuzuye-rwogutanga urwego rwibikorwa byubucuruzi, igishushanyo mbonera, ubwubatsi, kwishyira hamwe, ubwishingizi bufite ireme, kohereza ibicu, hamwe nibikorwa byacunzwe.
endToEndSolutions.row1P1: Amahugurwa afatanije, ikarita yubucuruzi ikarita yubucuruzi, hamwe nububiko bwububiko bwihariye bugamije gukuraho ingaruka mbere yumurongo wa code.
endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Turasobanura icyitegererezo cyamakuru, urwego rwumutekano, hamwe nintambwe yerekana ibipimo byerekana intsinzi ndende.
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Microservices modular, ubwoko-butekanye APIs, hamwe nibisubizo byimbere byahujwe nigice cyikora, kwishyira hamwe, hamwe na scan yumutekano.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Imiyoboro ikomeza yo guhuza hamwe nibikorwa bya GitHub, Terraform, hamwe nabashinzwe umutekano byikora.
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: Ibicu byinshi-bicu kuri AWS / Azure / GCP hamwe no gusubira inyuma byikora, kugabanuka kwa zeru, no kugihe nyacyo.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Dutanga SLA-dushyigikiwe no gukomeza telemetrie ikurikirana kugirango ihindure ibicuruzwa byawe nta nkomyi.
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Kubazwa ingingo imwe kumurongo wawe wose wa digitale - umuvuduko ukabije wihuta, guteganya ingengo yimishinga, no guhanga udushya.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Ibiranga ibintu bisanzwe kandi bigezweho bizakomeza umushinga wawe imbere yaya marushanwa.
endToEndSolutions.pillarsSub: Buri cyiciro cyakozwe na entreprise ya rigor.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Ubuvumbuzi bwa domeni, igishushanyo mbonera cyubwubatsi, hamwe no guhuza abafatanyabikorwa kugirango bakureho ingaruka zikorwa.
endToEndSolutions.pillar2Desc: Igicu gihamye-kavukire ya microservices, guhuza API, hamwe no kugerageza QA.
endToEndSolutions.pillar3Desc: Zero-kwizerana umutekano kubahiriza, gusohora kontineri, hamwe no kohereza ibicu byikora.
endToEndSolutions.pillar4Desc: 24/7 Gukurikirana SLA, telemeteri yubuzima, hamwe nubuhanga bukomeza bwihindurize.
endToEndSolutions.ctaSub: Dufite ubuzima bwuzuye bwikoranabuhanga kugirango itsinda ryanyu rishobore kwibanda kubisubizo byubucuruzi.

migrationServices.description: Kwimuka kwizewe, kwimuka kwimurage yumurage, ububiko bwububiko, nibikorwa remezo kububiko bugezweho bwububiko, buhujwe no guhora bigezweho kugirango byongere imbaraga kandi neza.
migrationServices.row1P1: Kwimuka kwimirimo idafite akazi muri AWS, Azure, na Google Cloud hamwe no kuvumbura mu buryo bwikora, gutegura imiraba, no guhagarika ubucuruzi bwa zeru.
migrationServices.row1P2: Turinganiza rehosting, guhinduranya, no gusubiramo kugirango duhindure igiciro cyose cya nyirubwite (TCO) nubwitonzi.
migrationServices.row2Title: Umutekano ETL & Automatic Data Data Kwemeza
migrationServices.row2P1: Kwigana ububiko bwimikorere, gusobanura igishushanyo, hamwe no kwinjiza cyane ETL imiyoboro hamwe no kugenzura amakuru 100%.
migrationServices.row2P2: Imyitozo ya zeru-yamanutse yerekana imyitozo yuzuye kandi ikomeza ubucuruzi.
migrationServices.row3P1: Kuvugurura umurage monoliths muri microservices nini yateguwe binyuze kuri Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) hamwe nigishushanyo mbonera cya IaC.
migrationServices.row3P2: Nyuma yimuka yimikorere yerekana no gutezimbere ibiciro byemeza ROI ako kanya.
migrationServices.row4P1: Ibitabo byageragejwe kurugamba rwibitabo, sisitemu zo gusubira inyuma, hamwe nuburyo bwo gusubira inyuma kubwamahoro yuzuye mumitima.
migrationServices.row4P2: Telemetrie yubuzima nyuma yimuka na 24/7 hypercare garanti yumusaruro utagira inenge.
migrationServices.pillarsSub: De-risque yimuka ishyigikiwe na SLAs yimishinga.
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: Canary irekura hamwe nububikoshingiro bubiri-kwandika sync kugirango urebe neza ko abakoresha badahagarara.
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Kugereranya cheque, kugenzura ubugenzuzi bwimigambi, hamwe nubwiyunge bwa ETL bwikora.
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Porotokole ikaze y’ibiza hamwe n’imyitozo yo kwitoza kugira ibyago muri buri cyiciro.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Uburenganzira bwibicu, politiki ya autoscaling, hamwe nubuyobozi bwibiciro burimo.
migrationServices.ctaSub: Umufatanyabikorwa hamwe na Oklut Technologies yuburyo bwubatswe, butagira ingaruka no kuvugurura amakuru.

pilotPrototyping.description: Iterambere ryihuse no kwemeza ibisubizo byikoranabuhanga kugirango harebwe niba bishoboka tekiniki, agaciro k’ubucuruzi, ibisabwa byo kwishyira hamwe, imikorere, nubunini mbere yo gushyira mubikorwa byuzuye.
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Guhindura igitekerezo mubisubizo byumushinga bisaba kwemeza imbere. Serivisi yacu ya PoC & Pilote isuzuma imbaraga zikoranabuhanga, guhangayikishwa no kugerageza guhuza ibikorwa, no kwemeza ubucuruzi ROI mbere yo kwiyemeza gushora imari.

pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: Kwihuta kwa MVP Prototyping & Ibipimo bya tekiniki

aiRobotics.intro: Ubuhanga bwa artificiel (AI) na Roboque bihindura uburyo ubucuruzi bukora muguhuza ibyemezo byubwenge hamwe no gutangiza byihuse. AI ifasha imashini gusesengura amakuru, kwiga imiterere, no gufata ibyemezo byubwenge, mugihe robotike izana ubwo bushobozi mwisi yumubiri kugirango ikore imirimo ifite umuvuduko, ubunyangamugayo, kandi ihamye.
aiRobotics.section1Text: Ibisubizo byacu bya AI na Robotics bifasha amashyirahamwe koroshya ibikorwa, kugabanya imbaraga zintoki, no kuzamura umusaruro mubikorwa bitandukanye. Duhereye kubikorwa byikora no gusesengura ibintu kugeza kuri robo yubwenge hamwe na sisitemu yubwenge, dutanga ikoranabuhanga rishya ryongera imikorere, igatera imbere, kandi rishyigikira ihinduka rya digitale.
aiRobotics.section2Text: Buri mikoranire, ibyemezo, nigikorwa gikoreshwa na sisitemu imwe ihujwe - guhindura amakuru mubisubizo mugihe nyacyo.

informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Isoko imwe yukuri kuri buri shami - yubatswe kugirango ihindure amakuru yimikorere mubyemezo ubucuruzi bwawe bushobora gukora uyumunsi.
informationReporting.section1Heading: Sisitemu imwe ihuriweho na buri metero ifite akamaro
informationReporting.section1P1: Amakuru & Raporo Sisitemu nibisubizo byingenzi byubucuruzi bifasha amashyirahamwe gukusanya, gucunga, no guhindura amakuru mubushishozi bufite ireme. Izi sisitemu zihuza amakuru aturuka mu mashami menshi, yemeza neza, ahoraho, nigihe nyacyo cyo kubona amakuru yubucuruzi akomeye. Mugutanga urubuga rwibanze rwo gucunga amakuru, amashyirahamwe arashobora kunoza imikorere igaragara, koroshya imikorere, no gushyigikira ibyemezo bifatika murwego rwose rwumushinga.
informationReporting.section1P2: Izi sisitemu zikoresha raporo zikora, isesengura, hamwe n’ibibaho kugirango bikurikirane imikorere, bikurikirane ibipimo byingenzi, kandi bitange raporo-nyayo. Mugabanye imbaraga zintoki no kunoza amakuru yukuri, ubucuruzi burashobora gufata ibyemezo byihuse kandi byiza.
informationReporting.section2Text: Hamwe no kurushaho kugaragara, kubahiriza, no gufatanya, Sisitemu yamakuru & Raporo Sisitemu ifasha amashyirahamwe kunoza inzira, kuzamura umusaruro, no guteza imbere ubucuruzi burambye mubidukikije.
informationReporting.ctaHeading: Uhe buri kipe ishusho imwe-nyayo yubucuruzi.

artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Imyaka myinshi, ubwenge bwubuhanga bwibikorwa byafatwaga nkubushobozi bwo hanze: icyitegererezo cyatojwe mukwigunga, kwerekana agasanduku k'umusenyi, cyangwa ikiganiro cyitaruye kigerwaho binyuze kumurongo wihariye. Uyu munsi, paradigima yarahindutse. Uruganda rukora cyane AI rwinjijwe muri sisitemu yo kwandika - ERPs, CRMs, urubuga rw’imari ya muntu, hamwe na moteri itanga aho ubucuruzi nyabwo bubera.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P2: Iyo ubwenge bukorera muri sisitemu yo kwandika, buragwa imipaka yumutekano yashizweho n’umuryango, imiterere yamakuru, hamwe n’ubucuruzi. Ntabwo itanga ibisubizo rusange; ikora kuri ordre nzima, isobanura amatike yingoboka ifunguye, ihuza inyemezabuguzi zitanga isoko, kandi ifasha abakozi mumasura nyayo bayobora buri munsi.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P3: Ihinduka ryimura software yimishinga kuva mububiko bwimbitse butegereza urufunguzo rwabantu mubikorwa byubaka byerekana ibyifuzo, gutangiza intambwe, hamwe nibisabwa mugihe gikwiye.
artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: Imashini gakondo ya robotike Yikora (RPA) yabaye indashyikirwa mugusiba ecran, gusubiramo. Nyamara, amategeko akomeye ashyiraho igihe cyose ifishi ihindutse, imiterere yinyandiko itunguranye igeze, cyangwa bidasanzwe. Ubwenge bwubwenge bukemura iki gice muguhuza ibitekerezo byubwenge nibikorwa byakozwe:

sec2List.text: Gutegura ibikorwa bigoye byambukiranya amashami, kuyobora imirimo ishingiye kubyihutirwa no gukemura amateka.
Kwinjiza PDF zitubatswe, imeri, ibicuruzwa byoherejwe, n'amasezerano, kubihindura mubikorwa byububiko.
Gutangiza ibyiciro byinshi byemewe-nko guhuza ibicuruzwa byaguzwe byinjira na banki.
Gukomeza gusesengura ibiti byakozwe kugirango umenye inzitizi zigihe cyigihe kandi utange inama yo kunonosora ibikorwa.

copilotCards.title: Gushakisha Amakuru
copilotCards.desc: Kugarura ibisobanuro mu bumenyi busaranganywa, politiki ya intranet, ibisobanuro byibicuruzwa, hamwe no gukemura amatike yamateka nta jambo ryibanze ukeka.

copilotCards.title: Incamake yinyandiko
copilotCards.desc: Guhita uhinyura RFP ndende, amasezerano y'abacuruzi, ibisobanuro bya tekiniki, hamwe no guhindura amategeko mumabwiriza ngufi akorwa hamwe no kugenzura ingaruka.

copilotCards.title: Ibisekuruza
copilotCards.desc: Gufasha gutegura ibyifuzo byabakiriya, inyandiko zikorwa, inzira zisanzwe zikorwa (SOPs), hamwe namakuru agezweho yabakiriya ahujwe nubuziranenge bwikirango.

copilotCards.title: Isesengura ryamakuru
copilotCards.desc: Guhindura ibibazo byabajijwe mubibazo bigoye byo gusesengura, kubyara incamake yimbonerahamwe no kwerekana ibyingenzi kubuyobozi.

copilotCards.title: Ibikorwa byubucuruzi
copilotCards.desc: Gutangiza ibikorwa biturutse kubiganiro-nko guteganya ibikoresho, gukora amatike, kuvugurura inyandiko, cyangwa gutanga ibyifuzo byubuguzi.

copilotCards.title: Uruhare-Rufatiro
copilotCards.desc: Kugenzura ibisubizo bya copilot wubaha byimazeyo urwego rwabakoresha, kubika imari yibanga, dosiye za HR, numutungo wubwenge urinzwe.

artificialIntelligence.sec4P1: Mugihe ibyitegererezo bibyara inyungu birenze gusobanukirwa no guhuza ururimi, ubwenge bwo guhanura bwibanda kumibare yimibare ihishe mumibare yimishinga. Icyitegererezo cyo guhanura giha imbaraga amashyirahamwe guteganya imbogamizi zikorwa mbere yo guhagarika ibikorwa:

sec4List.text: Guteganya ibyinjira byinjira, umuvuduko wibarura, hamwe nibisabwa byumutungo muguhuza ibipimo byigihe hamwe numuvuduko wigihe.
Kugaragaza ingaruka zabakiriya churn, kubungabunga inzinguzingo, no gutinda kumurongo mugihe haracyari igihe cyo gutabara.
Kwerekana ibintu bidasanzwe mubikorwa byubukungu, ibiti byubahirizwa, nuburyo bwo gutanga amasoko mbere yuko byiyongera.
Guhuza ibyateganijwe kugurishwa hamwe nubushobozi bwo gukora hamwe nububiko bwububiko kugirango urinde igishoro gikora.

artificialIntelligence.keyPerspectiveLead: AI ni iyo kwizerwa gusa nkamakuru fatizo munsi yayo nubuyobozi bubukikije. Kwemeza imishinga irambye bisaba disipuline yububiko nkana:

modernErp.title: Kwihutisha Guhindura Ubucuruzi hamwe na ERP igezweho
modernErp.subtitle: Shakisha uburyo urubuga rwa ERP rugezweho ruhuza imari, amasoko, urwego rutanga nibikorwa byubucuruzi binyuze mumushinga uhuriweho na digitale.
modernErp.imageCaption: Ikoranabuhanga mu bucuruzi - ERP & Ibikorwa byubucuruzi bihujwe

connectedFunctions.title: Gucunga imari
connectedFunctions.desc: Ivugurura ryibihe-nyabyo, kumenyekanisha kwinjiza mu buryo bwikora, no kwiyunga n’amafaranga menshi ako kanya.

connectedFunctions.title: Gutanga Urunigi & Ibikoresho
connectedFunctions.desc: Kurangiza-kurangira kubarura kugaragara, kubika neza ububiko, no gutanga telemetrie.

connectedFunctions.title: Umurwa mukuru wabantu & Workforce
connectedFunctions.desc: Kwikorera-abakozi ba portal, gukoresha umushahara wikora, hamwe no gutegura impano yubuzima.

connectedFunctions.title: Amasoko & Sourcing
connectedFunctions.desc: Kwemeza kugura byikora, kubahiriza amasezerano yubucuruzi, hamwe no gukoresha imbaraga zisesengura.

modernCapabilities.title: Igicu-Kavukire
modernCapabilities.desc: Ibipimo bya elastike byapimye bidafite ibikorwa remezo hejuru cyangwa verisiyo ihagarika gufunga.

modernCapabilities.title: Fungura API Ecosystem
modernCapabilities.desc: Ihuza ryubatswe ryambere rishobora guhuza inzira-ebyiri zamakuru guhuza hamwe na microservices yihariye na suite ya CRM.

modernCapabilities.title: Isesengura ryashyizwemo
modernCapabilities.desc: Ikibaho cyibanze kiva kumpapuro zo murwego rwo hejuru murwego rwo kugurisha.

modernCapabilities.title: Imikorere Yikora Yikora
modernCapabilities.desc: Ibyabaye-byatewe nibyabaye bitera gukora ibikorwa bisanzwe byambukiranya amashami byigenga.

erpBusinessBenefits: Inkomoko imwe yukuri ikuraho raporo zishami zivuguruzanya
Kugabanuka gukabije mukwezi kurangira nigihembwe cyanyuma
Ibarura-nyaryo hamwe na logistique igaragara igabanya ububiko
Yagabanije IT kubungabunga hejuru binyuze mubicu-bigezweho
Guhuriza hamwe kubahiriza gukurikirana imisoro myinshi yo mu karere
Kwihuta byihuse kubintu byaguzwe mugusangira ibikorwa
erpStrategyPoints: Guhuza ubwubatsi bwa ERP hamwe nibikorwa byibanze bikora mbere yimiterere
Guhitamo moderi yoherejwe kugirango tumenye intsinzi yihuse
Gushyira imbere ubuziranenge bwo hejuru bwibanze bwo kwimuka no kwiyunga
Gushyiramo imiyoborere yimikorere ihindagurika hamwe na gahunda zamahugurwa ajyanye ninshingano
Gutegura amarembo ya API yo kwagura kwishyira hamwe kwaguka
modernErp.sec1Subtext: ERP ntikiri ibaruramari ryinyuma gusa. Nuburyo bukora bwibikorwa bigezweho bigaragarira muri software.
modernErp.sec2Subtext: Agaciro nyako k'umuteguro kagaragara iyo ibikorwa byingenzi byubucuruzi bihurira hamwe kuri fondasiyo isangiwe.
modernErp.sec3Subtext: Gusenya urukuta rwitumanaho hagati yishami kugirango bishoboke gutemba, guhuza ibikorwa byumushinga.
modernErp.sec4Subtext: Guhuriza hamwe ibipimo ngenderwaho mubikorwa byubuyobozi buboneye byerekana ibikorwa byubucuruzi bigezweho.
modernErp.sec5Subtext: Ibiranga imyubakire itandukanya urubuga rwa ERP rwiki gihe nubushakashatsi bukomeye.
modernErp.sec6Subtext: Guhuza ibikorwa byingenzi byubucuruzi muburyo bumwe bwa digitale itanga umusaruro ushimishije.
modernErp.ctaDescription: Shakisha uburyo urubuga rwa ERP rugezweho ruhuza imari, amasoko, urwego rutanga nibikorwa byubucuruzi binyuze mumushinga uhuriweho na digitale.
modernErp.sec1P1: Mubikorwa byihuta byimishinga, sisitemu gakondo yo gutegura umutungo wa Enterprises akenshi irwana. Yubatswe mugihe cyo gutunganya ibyiciro hamwe na seriveri yihariye, umurage ERPs washyizweho cyane, bigoye kuzamura, kandi birababaje. Ibikorwa byubucuruzi byingenzi byakoraga muri silo ibangikanye, bishingiye kubintu byoroshye byoherezwa hanze kugirango bihuze ibitabo hamwe nububiko.
modernErp.sec1P2: Ibigezweho, igicu-kavukire ERP isobanura mubyukuri iyi dinamike. Ikora nk'umugongo uhuriweho na digitale yumushinga - umusingi muzima aho imari, amasoko, urwego rutanga, ibarura, hamwe nabakozi bakorera muburyo bwamakuru asangiwe.
modernErp.sec1P3: Muguzana ibikorwa byibanze mubidukikije bihujwe, ERP igezweho ikuraho ahantu hatabona imikorere idindiza iterambere, bigatuma abayobozi bayobora ubucuruzi bakoresheje ibimenyetso bifatika aho kuba incamake yamateka.
modernErp.sec3P1: Silos ikora ni gake abantu ibibazo; nibibazo byubwubatsi. Iyo serivisi zabakiriya, amasoko, hamwe nitsinda ryububiko bikora mubisabwa bitagabanijwe, buri handoff isaba imeri yintoki, urupapuro rwabigenewe, hamwe na terefone. Amakosa aragwira, inyemezabuguzi zifatwa, kandi ibyemezo byabakiriya biranyerera.
modernErp.sec3P2: ERP igezweho ikemura iki kibazo binyuze mumirongo ihuriweho hamwe na gahunda yo gutangiza ibyabaye:

sec3List.text: Iyo urutonde rwabakiriya rushyizwe, ububiko bwibikoresho byikora, ibirango byohereza ibyara, hamwe na fagitire zo kwishyuza zivugururwa ako kanya.
Kugura ibicuruzwa, inyemezabuguzi y'ibicuruzwa, hamwe na fagitire y'abacuruzi bihura mu buryo bwikora n'ubwiyunge bw'inzira 3, byerekana gusa ibitemewe byo gusuzuma abantu.
Urupapuro rwumushinga, amafaranga yimishahara, hamwe namakarita yimikoreshereze yimikorere yerekanwe kubiciro byigihe.

modernErp.sec4P1: Gukora uruganda rutagaragara neza ni nko kuguruka mu gihu cyinshi hamwe nibikoresho byatinze. ERP igezweho itanga telemeteri nyayo murwego rwose rwubucuruzi:

sec4List.text: Ako kanya kureba ibintu byuzuye, gukora amafaranga atemba, gufungura imyenda, no gutondekanya ibirarane udategereje igihe cyo kurangiza.
Abayobozi b'amashami barashobora kubaka ibibazo byabigenewe hanyuma bakamanuka kuva murwego rwincamake kurwego rwibikorwa byumurongo.
Kurandura imibare ivuguruzanya mugushiraho amakuru yingenzi agenga abakiriya, abacuruzi, na kataloge y'ibicuruzwa.
Imenyekanisha ryikora rimenyesha abayobozi ako kanya iyo marge igabanutse munsi yumubare, ibarura rikora hasi, cyangwa ibicuruzwa bitanga ibicuruzwa.

modernErp.keyPerspectiveLead: Ihinduka rya ERP rigezweho rigenda neza iyo amashyirahamwe ayifata nko kuzamura imikorere yubwihindurize aho kuba IT-ihungabana-byose.

cybersecurity.title: Kubaka Cyber Kurwanya Ibikorwa Byahujwe
cybersecurity.subtitle: Shakisha uburyo amashyirahamwe ashobora gushimangira umutekano, kurinda sisitemu zikomeye no gutegura iterabwoba mubidukikije bigenda bihuzwa.
cybersecurity.imageCaption: Ikoranabuhanga rya Entreprise Ibitekerezo - Kubangamira Defence & Zero-Kwizera

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Telemetry & Kumenya
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Igihe nyacyo cyo kwinjiza hamwe na SIEM anomaly ihuriro hejuru yibicu byose hamwe nibikorwa byakazi.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Ibirimo & Kwigunga
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Amategeko ya karantine yimikorere yigenga atandukanya ibintu byangiritse cyangwa ibyangombwa.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Gukosora & Imizi-Impamvu
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Kwihuta byihuse hamwe nubucamanza bwa digitale bugaragaza neza ibyangiritse.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Kwihangana & Gukomera
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Gukomeza gutanga ibitekerezo muburyo budasubirwaho, kubika politiki, hamwe no kwigana umutuku-itsinda.

cyberBusinessBenefits: Kugabanuka gukabije kugabanuka kwibasirwa hejuru yumutungo wibicu
Bijejwe gukomeza ibikorwa no gukiza ibiza hamwe na RTO / RPO ntoya
Icyizere cyuzuye cyo kubahiriza ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, na GDPR
Kurinda umutungo wibanze wumushinga wubwenge hamwe nibanga ryabakiriya
Abacuruzi boroheje hamwe n’imiyoborere y’abandi bantu binyuze mu kugenzura uburyo bumwe
Kongera abakiriya hamwe nabashoramari ikizere gishyigikiwe na zeru-umutekano wizewe
zeroTrustPrinciples: Ntukigere Wizera, Buri gihe Kugenzura: Kwemeza neza bisabwa kuri buri gikorwa
Byibuze-Agaciro Kubona: Imipaka y'uruhare runini rugabanya urujya n'uruza
Fata Kurenga: Gukomeza gukurikirana iterabwoba, kugenzura muri transit no kuruhuka
Micro-Segmentation: Urubuga rwa firewall rutandukanya imirimo ya buri muntu
Gukomeza Telemetrie: Isesengura ryimyitwarire yimikorere yerekana ibyifuzo bidasanzwe
cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Nkuko amashyirahamwe agezweho ahuza porogaramu nyinshi, ibidukikije byigicu, abakozi ba kure, ibikoresho bigendanwa, hamwe nabandi bafatanyabikorwa, perimetero yumutekano gakondo ireka kubaho.
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Ibikorwa birinda ibikorwa remezo bikomeye, amakuru yibigo byoroshye, hamwe na sisitemu y'imikorere.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: Indangamuntu nindege igenzura ishingiro ryumutekano ugezweho. Hafi y'ibibazo byose bihungabanya umutekano bitangirana nibyangombwa byangiritse aho gukoresha software.
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: Zero Icyizere ntabwo igicuruzwa cyangwa igikoresho kimwe. Nuburyo bwububiko bushingiye ku ihame ryeruye: ntukizere ikintu na kimwe imbere cyangwa hanze y'urusobekerane.
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Kurinda imizigo yakazi hejuru yibicu rusange, ubwubatsi bwa Hybrid, hamwe nibidukikije bikwirakwizwa.
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Kurwanya cyber kweli byemera ko ibintu bishobora kubaho. Kwitegura byibanda kubintu byihuse, guhagarika ubucuruzi buke, no kugarura neza.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Kubaka uruganda rukora cyber rurinda agaciro k'umuteguro, guhagarara neza, no kumenyekana ku isoko.
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Shakisha uburyo amashyirahamwe ashobora gushimangira umutekano, kurinda sisitemu zikomeye no gutegura iterabwoba mubidukikije bigenda bihuzwa.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: Mugihe cyumurage wibikorwa bya IT, umutekano wakoreraga ku nyubako yikigo: ibintu byose biri mumurongo wibiro byibigo byafatwaga nkuwizeye, mugihe ibintu byose byo hanze byafatwaga nkutizera. Isosiyete imwe ya firewall yarinze seriveri y'imbere, ububikoshingiro, na mudasobwa ya desktop.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Uruganda rwubu rwarenze inkuta zumubiri. Imirimo ikora iba ahantu h'ibicu byinshi (AWS, Azure, GCP), abakozi bagera kuri porogaramu zubucuruzi baturutse ahantu hatandukanye, kandi APIs zihora zihana amakuru yimikorere yibikorwa bitanga ibikoresho byo hanze, ibigo by'imari, n'abacuruzi ba SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3: Mugihe iyi hyper-ihuza itwara ubucuruzi bukomeye, yagura cyane ibitero byibasiye. Buri API iherezo, ibimenyetso biranga, igikoresho kigendanwa gihujwe, hamwe na SaaS kwishyira hamwe byerekana icyerekezo gishobora kugaragara. Kurinda ibigo byukuri bisaba kuva muburinzi bushingiye kuri perimeteri ukagera kubikorwa byanyuma, bikarangira bikarangira.

sec2Cards.title: Kumenya
sec2Cards.desc: Imashini yiga-ifashwa nubwenge bwiterabwoba ikurikirana uburyo bwurusobe rudasanzwe, gukoresha nabi ibyemezo, hamwe nintege nke zumunsi mugihe nyacyo.

sec2Cards.title: Gukurikirana Umutekano
sec2Cards.desc: Ikigo gishinzwe umutekano gikora ibikorwa (SOC) telemetrie ihuza ibyabaye muri seriveri, ihuriro rya kontineri, abatanga indangamuntu, hamwe n’ibisobanuro.

sec2Cards.title: Gucunga intege nke
sec2Cards.desc: Gukomeza kwangirika kwimikorere yibikorwa remezo, ububiko bwinkomoko yububiko, hamwe niyandikisha rya kontineri kugirango bikosore intege nke.

sec2Cards.title: Kurinda amakuru
sec2Cards.desc: Kwibanga gukomeye mu gutambuka (TLS 1.3) no kuruhuka (AES-256), hamwe n’imiyoborere yo gukumira amakuru yatanzwe (DLP) kugirango hirindwe imitungo y’ubwenge.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: Kurinda umutungo wibigo bisaba kwemeza ko indangamuntu yose - yaba umuyobozi wumuntu, umushoramari wo hanze, cyangwa konti ya serivise yigenga - yemeye uburenganzira kubutunzi nyabwo ibona.

sec3List.text: Kwinjira-Kwinjira (SSO) hamwe na federasiyo ya indangamuntu ikuraho ububiko bwibanga bwacitsemo ibice muri porogaramu.
Urufunguzo rwibikoresho bya FIDO2 hamwe nimbogamizi zishingiye kubibazo bijyanye nibikorwa byubuyobozi byoroshye.
Uruhare rwiza-Uruhare rushingiye (RBAC) hamwe na Attribute-ishingiye (ABAC) igenzura ryashyizwe mubikorwa kurwego rwa API nububiko.
Gutanga by'agateganyo, gusa-mu-gihe (JIT) kwinjira birangira mu buryo bwikora iyo imirimo y'ubuyobozi irangiye.

cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveLead: Mububiko bwa Zero Icyizere, kwizerana gushingiye kumiterere y'urusobe birasenyutse rwose. Igicuruzwa cyose, ikibazo cyububiko, hamwe n’umukoresha winjira bigomba guhora byerekana ko byemewe:

cloudSecurityCards.title: Inshingano Zisangiwe
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Imiyoborere isobanutse itandukanya ibicu bitanga umutekano wibikorwa remezo ninshingano zumushinga wo kubika amakuru, politiki ya IAM, hamwe na kode yo gusaba.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Ibikorwa Remezo nka Code (IaC)
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Ibidahinduka, byumvikana ibicu bigenzurwa binyuze muri code. Politiki yikora-nk-code ya scaneri ihagarika ibishushanyo mbonera hamwe nindobo zerekanwe mbere yo koherezwa.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Ibikoresho & Kubernetes Umutekano
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Gukoresha kontineri ikarishye, iyandikwa ryamashusho, rezo ya micro-segmentation, hamwe nubuyobozi bwibanga bwikora butuma ibyangombwa bitabikwa mububiko.

cloudModernization.title: Kuvugurura Umurage Porogaramu Kuri Igicu
cloudModernization.subtitle: Shakisha uburyo bufatika bwo gusuzuma, kuvugurura no kwimura umurage porogaramu igana ku gipimo kinini, gifite umutekano.
cloudModernization.imageCaption: Ibikorwa bya Tekinoroji Yumushinga - Igicu-Kavukire Kongera guhuza & Konteneri

modernizationApproaches.title: Rehost (Lift & Shift)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Inzibacyuho yakazi kumashini yibicu byihuse hamwe na code ntoya.

modernizationApproaches.title: Gusubiramo (Lift & Reshape)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Kuzamura uburyo bwo gukora, kwemeza ibicu byabitswe, no koroshya ibikorwa.

modernizationApproaches.title: Imashini (Igicu-Kavukire)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Kwubaka monoliths muri microservices ya kontineri hamwe na seriveri iterwa na seriveri idafite API.

modernizationApproaches.title: Simbuza (SaaS Igezweho)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Kuruhuka sisitemu yumurage utagira ingano kugirango ushyigikire porogaramu igamije ibicuruzwa.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Isuzuma ry'umurage
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Ikarita yerekana ikarita yo gushushanya, gutondekanya imyenda ya tekiniki, no gutanga amanota.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Intego yo Kwubaka
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Igishushanyo mbonera cya microservice, igishushanyo mbonera cya kontineri, hamwe na IaC byikora.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Kwimuka Icyiciro
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Canary irekura, ikomatanya-kwandika amakuru guhuza, hamwe na zero-yamanutse yo kugabanuka.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Gukwirakwiza Igicu
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Gukomeza gucunga ibiciro, autoscaling telemetry, hamwe na FinOps isubiramo imikorere.

cloudModernizationBenefits: Ikigaragara cyo hasi ibikorwa remezo byo kubungabunga no gukoresha ibikoresho byo kugarura ibikoresho
Hafi ya infinite compte elastique ikemura impinga yimishinga yimodoka hamwe nubukererwe bwa zeru
Kwihuta kurekura umuvuduko hamwe numuyoboro wuzuye wa CI / CD wuzuye
Kurandura umurage ingingo imwe yo kunanirwa hamwe na AZ nyinshi iboneka
Imyubakire ya API igezweho ituma abafatanyabikorwa bahuza byihuse
Iterambere ryigihe-nyacyo mubikorwa mubikorwa no gukoresha ibicu
landscapeAssessmentPoints: Gushushanya amakarita aringaniye hagati ya porogaramu hamwe na data guhuza amakuru
Kumenya ibishushanyo mbonera by’ibidukikije hamwe na base de base de base
Gusuzuma iyubahirizwa ryamabwiriza nimbogamizi zubusugire bwamakuru kuri buri bubasha
Kubara Ikiguzi Cyuzuye Igiciro cya Nyirubwite (TCO) hakurya ya reaction hamwe n'inzira za rehost
Gushiraho umurongo usobanutse wo kurinda ibikorwa byubucuruzi bya buri munsi
cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Gusaza monoliths ibuza umuvuduko wo guhanga udushya, kongera intege nke zikorwa, no kongera amafaranga yo gufata neza ibikorwa remezo.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Igezweho ryibicu bigezweho bitangirana no gusuzuma neza. Gusimbuka mu buryo butaziguye kwimuka utabanje kugenzura ibyifuzo biterwa nimpamvu yambere yo gutinda gukata.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Nta ngamba-imwe-ihuza ingamba zose zo kwimuka. Inganda ziyobora zihuye nuburyo bukwiye bwo kuvugurura kuri buri gikorwa cyakazi gishingiye ku gaciro k’ubucuruzi, byihutirwa, n’umwenda wa tekiniki.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Igishushanyo mbonera cyerekana uburyo bwo guhindura umurage monoliths muri serivise zoroshye, zifite umutekano, kandi zishobora kubungabungwa.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Kwimura sisitemu yumurage muburyo bugezweho bwububiko butanga ibikorwa bifatika kandi byateganijwe.
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Shakisha uburyo bufatika bwo gusuzuma, kuvugurura no kwimura umurage usaba kugana ibicu binini, bifite umutekano.
cloudModernization.sec1P1: Inshingano zingenzi zubatswe zubatswe hashize imyaka icumi ziracyatwara miliyari yinjiza imishinga, nyamara imyubakire yabo yububiko itera ingaruka zikomeye kubikorwa.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Buri ruganda ruhura nubushyamirane hagati yo gutuza no kuvugurura. Sisitemu yumurage yakozwe muburyo burambye, kandi ikora neza mumyaka. Ariko, nkuko ibisabwa mubucuruzi byihuta, iyi myubakire yubusaza ihura nimbibi zubatswe:

sec1List.text: Codebase ya monolithic yubatswe kumurongo utaye agaciro hamwe no kugabanuka kwimpano zihari zo kubungabunga.
Ibice bifatanye cyane aho guhindura ikintu kimwe bishobora guhungabanya imikorere yimikorere idafitanye isano.
Imipaka ihanitse isaba kugura ibyuma bihenze cyane kugirango bikemure ibihe byihuta.
Kudashobora guhuza neza na porogaramu zigendanwa zigezweho, imiyoboro yabakiriya, cyangwa abafatanyabikorwa API badafite inyandiko zoroshye.
Seriveri yumubiri ibyumba byubuzima, gusubira inyuma, hamwe nimbaraga nyinshi / gukonjesha ibikorwa.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Urugendo rugezweho rwo kuvugurura rutangirana no kwerekana neza neza umutungo uriho:

sec2List.text: Gutondekanya imirimo yose ikora, module yihariye, inyandiko zinyuma, hamwe namateka yabandi.
Gushushanya ikarita igoye yo guhuza, imbonerahamwe yububiko, gusangira sisitemu ya dosiye itaziguye, n'amasezerano ya serivisi yo hanze.
Gusuzuma imiterere yamakuru, ibisabwa mubusugire bwibikorwa, kugarura cadence, namategeko agenga ubusugire.
Kugenzura CPU, kwibuka, gukoresha ububiko, hamwe numuyoboro winjira muburyo bunini bwibipimo byerekana igicu.
Gutondekanya porogaramu murwego rwo gushushanya umutekano, kwimuka kwimuka hamwe nuburyo bugaragara bwo gusubira inyuma.

cloudModernization.sec4P1: Icyerekezo cyubwubatsi gikuramo porogaramu yibanze muburyo bwa modular, kontineri yakiriwe kurubuga rwibicu byoroshye (nka Kubernetes cyangwa gucunga seriveri idafite gahunda).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Mugushiraho imiyoboro ya CI / CD ikoreshwa, ibyuma byubururu byatsi-icyatsi kibisi, hamwe nibikorwa remezo nka code, ibyoherejwe bihinduka kuva muri wikendi yibyabaye muri wikendi bigahinduka mubikorwa bya buri munsi.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: Imashini ya Elastike ihita yipima mugihe cyo kwiyongera kwinshi no kugabanuka mugihe cyo gutuza, bikuraho ibiciro byubusa mugihe byemeza inshuro ya kabiri isubiza kubakoresha isi.
